messages:
maria: Heads up — paging adapter (us-east) heartbeat is oscillating, incidentbot suppressed outbound pages for ~20m. Seeing repeated reconnects.
sre-bot: ALERT: paged-service.adapter.us-east heartbeat flapping (count=42) — suppression triggered :warning:
jonathan: Any customer impact yet?
maria: A few customers reported delayed pages to SMS/email. Pager history shows retries but incidentbot skipped actual pages due to suppression window.
devon: Can you paste the adapter logs around the disconnects?
maria: logs:
```
[2026-03-17T09:02:11Z] adapter: heartbeat miss (seq=17)
[2026-03-17T09:02:12Z] adapter: reconnecting to broker
[2026-03-17T09:02:13Z] adapter: heartbeat restore
[2026-03-17T09:02:31Z] adapter: heartbeat miss (seq=18)
```
jonathan: Looks like noise filter is treating short reconnects as sustained flapping. Did recent deploy change debounce timer?
devon: Yes — deploy last night tightened the heartbeat debounce (FF: adapter.heartbeat.filter=true, debounce_ms=500). That made it too sensitive under transient broker jitter.
oncall-lead: I can jump in to pager manually if needed — who should we @page?
maria: Please page oncall rotation manually and escalate for any customer-facing alerts. I'll try a quick mitigation: flip the noise filter off and bounce the adapter.
ops-esc: Approved to flip flag and restart. Minimal risk.
maria: Running:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/paging-adapter ADAPTER_HEARTBEAT_FILTER=false
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/paging-adapter
```
pagerbot: Manual page issued for critical alerts to @oncall-rotation :rotating_light:
jonathan: After restart, metrics look stable. No missed pages in the last 6 minutes.
devon: We'll revert debounce change and add a staged ramp to avoid sensitivity. Patch: revert PR #4823 and add config test for broker jitter.
maria: Mitigation complete — suppression cleared, adapter heartbeats stable. Monitoring on for 60m. Filing a postmortem and follow-up action: tighter healthcheck telemetry + config gate for debounce changes.
oncall-lead: Acknowledged. I'll follow up with impacted customer list and coordinate comms.
ops-esc: Thanks team. Please add incident timeline to the incident board and tag SRE/ENG-PLAT for the config change review. :thumbsup:
note: thread documents contain chronological messages as a single continuous string
